verdict.rationale: YYLO documents a 'bounded concurrent fan-out' parallel-runner for independent kanban tasks with structured evidence per item, plus run-until-completion looping, which supports running multiple agent tasks concurrently. However, evidence lacks details on concurrency limits, scaling numbers, resource isolation at scale, or independent/hands-on validation of throughput gains. missing for 10: concrete concurrency limits/benchmarks, independent third-party validation of parallel scaling, evidence of large-scale (10s-100s of tasks) usage in production.
